description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelRemoveButtonMeetings class, which extends SugarWidgetField and provides methods for rendering a remove button in a subpanel context within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework, specifically for the Meetings subpanel. It includes logic for generating URLs and handling user interactions for removing meetings from a relationship.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelRemoveButtonMeetings
classes.description: A widget class for rendering a remove button in the subpanel for Meetings, extending the SugarWidgetField base class.

methods.name: displayHeaderCell
methods.description: Returns a non-breaking space as the header cell content for the subpanel column.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the remove button link in the subpanel list view, handling URL construction, access to global variables, and user confirmation prompts.
